name: Smoothed 2D Supervision
aliases: Smoothed 2D Supervision — BL, Progressive Gaussian Blurring
definition: A technique to blur 2D training images with a parallel set of scheduled 2D Gaussian kernels to produce smoothed image gradients, stabilize camera alignment, and restrict the spectrum of the learned 3D scene.
summary: Smoothed 2D Supervision stabilizes joint optimization by progressively blurring 2D training images with Gaussian kernels, distinguishing itself by operating directly on the image space rather than modifying the 3D representation.
